sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval

assessment.benefit: Lilly reported detailed Phase 3 TRIUMPH-2 results on 29 September 2026 in adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight. Retatrutide remains investigational.

sources.title: Enicepatide CT388-104 Phase II results
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval

assessment.stage: Phase III ENITH-1/2 ongoing; separate Phase II diabetes results
assessment.summary: Roche reported CT388-104 results on 22 September 2026 in adults with type 2 diabetes and overweight or obesity. ENITH-1/2 weight-management trials are ongoing; additional diabetes and cardiovascular Phase III studies are planned for the first half of 2027.
assessment.limitations: Sponsor-reported results; gastrointestinal adverse events and discontinuations occurred. Planned studies and research results do not establish UK authorisation, NHS access or supply.

sources.title: Elecoglipron Phase IIb results and Phase III plans
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
sources.assessment: AstraZeneca reported VISTA and SOLSTICE results and advancement into EMBOLD obesity and ELUMINATE diabetes development. This does not verify initiation of every planned trial. Gastrointestinal adverse events were common. Obesity, diabetes, combination and outcome studies require separate stage checks.

sources.title: Kailera Q2 2026 programme update
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
sources.assessment: Kailera reports ongoing KaiNETIC studies and full enrolment of a separate higher-dose Phase IIb trial. Injection evidence cannot establish oral-stage progress; registry status needs verification. Kailera reports oral results from China and plans global Phase III initiation in the first half of 2027. Planned initiation is not completed initiation. Kailera's oral programme and Hengrui's Chinese programme have different development stages. Keep sponsor, geography and study distinct. Kailera reports early triple-agonist data from China and plans global Phase I in 2026. Global initiation not verified.

sources.title: Olatorepatide Chinese NDA acceptance
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
sources.assessment: Hansoh reports Chinese acceptance of its weight-management application for a weekly GLP-1/GIP injection. Acceptance is not marketing approval. Regeneron is the partner outside Hansoh's retained territories. Do not confuse this asset with the Hansoh/Merck oral programme or infer a UK licence.

sources.title: Apitegromab with tirzepatide: EMBRAZE Phase 2 paper
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
sources.assessment: The EMBRAZE paper reports less lean-mass loss with the combination over 24 weeks; exploratory physical-function measures showed no notable group differences. Lean mass is not equivalent to strength or function. Adverse events included gastrointestinal symptoms. The current pipeline page does not establish continuing obesity development; do not classify this as an advancing obesity programme or infer an obesity indication from another indication.

sources.title: COURAGE Phase 2 body-composition findings
sources.reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
sources.assessment: Regeneron reported body-composition findings for these experimental combinations. The triplet had more discontinuations and two deaths; the sponsor did not establish causation. This is an older coverage omission, not a September 2026 result. Safety, functional outcomes and current programme status require further review. Do not portray lean-mass preservation as an established clinical benefit.
